summary.headline: Fabtech Q2 FY27 revenue rose 22.8% QoQ to INR 92.09 crore and EBITDA doubled to INR 15.57 crore, with margin at 16%.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue from operations rose 22.8% QoQ to INR 920.9 million, with EBITDA up 110% QoQ to INR 155.7 million and margin up 647 bps to 16%. Reported PAT was INR 150.2 million, but it included an exceptional item of INR 65.9 million net of tax; adjusted PAT was INR 84.5 million (9.2% margin). H1 remains weak versus last year, with Q2 revenue down about 24% YoY per an analyst's calculation, and management says execution is weighted to H2. Order book is about INR 900 crore, roughly 2.2x last year's revenue, and management reiterated 25-30% growth and an 8-9% adjusted PAT margin for FY27.

financial_highlights.value: INR 235 crore; net of ECL about INR 226 crore

segments.name: Saudi Arabia
segments.commentary: Largest market at INR 462 million, up 18.5% YoY; operates via a JV, with non-pharma (Aramco, SABIC, government) bids under way.

segments.name: Africa (Morocco, Kenya, Algeria)
segments.commentary: Contributed about INR 470 million combined; management names Africa and Saudi as key pipeline contributors.

segments.name: India
segments.commentary: Now about 16% of revenue; management cites a real turnaround in the core standalone business.

guidance_outlook: FY27 guidance unchanged: 25-30% YoY growth targeted, with execution weighted to H2 and Q4 the heaviest quarter.
Adjusted PAT margin of 8-9% expected at end of FY27.

Analyst math: 25% growth implies roughly INR 510-515 crore revenue for FY27 and about INR 335-340 crore in H2; management said about 30% of H2 WIP material is already ready and the target is being adhered to on an annualised basis.
Margin expansion of 2-3% each from alternative sourcing and localisation/procurement; expected to build over 2-3 years.
Over the next 3-5 years, management targets 25-30% growth; ROE targeted to reach about 30% in two to three years.
European acquisition expected to close within about six months or in Q1 FY28; an operational opportunity in Europe is targeted for Q4 FY27 or Q1 FY28, subject to due diligence.
Receivables: most collections expected in Q3 and Q4; operating cash flow targeted positive by March 2027.
Billing is currently on shipment basis; move to project-completion revenue recognition targeted around FY28.
capex_capacity: Order book of over INR 900 crore; about INR 700 crore is commercially cleared and on the floor for detail engineering.
Management expects to add INR 500-600 crore of orders to sustain a 25-30% run rate; another INR 800-850 crore of conversions expected over the next 12 months (Middle East and Africa).
Hot pipeline quoted at INR 3,600-4,000 crore; about 20% of pipeline is PEB/civil scope, still in incubation, with numbers expected in H2 FY27 or H1 FY28.
Land purchase at Khalapur for INR 18.6 crore; use to be disclosed by H2 results.
IPO proceeds utilisation (working capital, general corporate purposes, inorganic) expected to be completed by end FY27; surplus cash of over INR 200 crore to fund acquisitions or working capital.
demand_pricing: West Asia geopolitical disruption raised freight, raw material costs and site security costs; management says pipeline was not cancelled but conversions were delayed.
Management says international projects are backed by LC/LoC, giving payment security; receivables slowdown attributed to geopolitics.
Pricing described as cutthroat and culture-dependent; references are used to justify lower margins on some projects, such as a vaccine project in India taken at lower margin.
Named competitors: Telstar, Jacobs, Exyte Engineering. Data centre scope of about 30% of contract value that Fabtech can execute.
Management says the Italy/European acquisition would raise success rate in Africa and Middle East from 10% to 20%.

qa_highlights.question: Q2 revenue down about 24% YoY and H1 down about 12%; is the 20-25% FY27 guidance intact, and what does H2 imply?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said guidance is unchanged and H2 is weighted by execution and the INR 900 crore order book, with Q2 last year having concentrated milestones. The target is 25-30% YoY growth and an 8-9% margin path.

qa_highlights.question: What revenue and margin is expected from PEB and civil works?
qa_highlights.answer: PEB is about 20% of the pipeline; the business is still in incubation, with specific numbers likely after a year, possibly H2 FY27 or H1 FY28.

qa_highlights.question: Status and timing of the Italy/European acquisition?
qa_highlights.answer: Moving positively; closing expected within six months or in Q1 of next year. Rationale: local manufacturing, product diversification, European references and procurement clauses from European development banks.

qa_highlights.question: Saudi JV size and disclosure timing?
qa_highlights.answer: JV already in place, enabling entry into electromechanical and non-pharma sectors (Aramco, SABIC, government). Disclosure expected in about one quarter, once team and pipeline are set.

qa_highlights.question: Receivables and collections?
qa_highlights.answer: Gross receivables INR 235 crore; net about INR 226 crore; not due about INR 145 crore; overdue about INR 81 crore, including about INR 25 crore retention; about INR 50 crore being pursued for collection in coming months.

qa_highlights.question: Why did operating cash flow turn negative and when will it turn positive?
qa_highlights.answer: Other current assets rose by about INR 38 crore, mainly vendor advances for H2 execution. Management targets positive operating cash flow by March 2027.

risks_watch: Revenue recognition currently on shipment basis; project-completion method not expected until FY28.
Receivables overdue about INR 81 crore; collections dependent on Q3-Q4 and geopolitics.
H2 needs roughly 2x H1 revenue to meet guidance; watch Q3 revenue and whether H2 WIP converts.
Operating cash flow was negative in H1 (about INR 41 crore outflow as stated) and vendor advances are rising.
Undisclosed details on Italy/European acquisition, Saudi JV, PEB and the Khalapur land; related-party sales commissions (INR 3.6 crore to G7 Universal LLC in FY25) likely to recur.
Reported PAT includes INR 65.9 million exceptional item; underlying earnings quality to monitor.
summary.management_tone: Confident on H2 and the order book, but evasive on specifics: PEB numbers, JV size, acquisition economics and EPS accretion were deferred or declined. Management acknowledged geopolitical and receivables pressure while stressing LC backing and steady execution.
key_quotes: We know where we are going and we have built the capabilities to get there and we are focused on delivery.
So the first thing that every tender asks is show me where you have done this before. That is the reference projects.
There is no free lunch, right?

adds.what: Khalapur land purchase for INR 18.6 crore; use to be disclosed by H2 results (no productive capacity stated)

growth.why: FY27 guidance of 25-30% YoY growth held (midpoint ~27.5%), backed by a ~INR 900 crore order book of which ~INR 700 crore is commercially cleared and ~30% of H2 WIP material reported ready, but no new productive capacity is stated and H1 revenue is down ~24% YoY per analyst math, so the back-half ramp is unproven.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Q2 EBITDA margin rose to 16% (+647 bps QoQ) and adjusted PAT margin guided at 8-9% for FY27 vs 9.2% in Q2, but H1 adjusted PAT margin was far lower and the 2-3% procurement gains are to build over 2-3 years.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: No new productive capacity is stated; only the INR 18.6 crore Khalapur land purchase with use to be disclosed by H2 results, and the Italy acquisition is not yet closed.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Management targets 25-30% YoY growth backed by a ~INR 900 crore order book, of which ~INR 700 crore is commercially cleared, but H1 revenue is down ~12% YoY and H2 needs roughly 2x H1.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Khalapur land use to be disclosed by H2 results and the Saudi JV size disclosure is expected in about one quarter, but no utilisation figure is given to force a capex call.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: FY27 revenue guidance of 25-30% was only held, not raised, and H1 revenue is down about 12% YoY with H2 needing roughly 2x H1.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Adjusted PAT margin guidance was cut to 8-9%, the Italy close slipped to within six months or Q1 FY28, and H2 must deliver about INR 335-340 crore against H1 weakness and negative operating cash flow of about INR 41 crore.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: PEB/civil scope (about 20% of the INR 3,600-4,000 crore hot pipeline) is still in incubation, with numbers expected in H2 FY27 or H1 FY28.

rows.label: Italy/European acquisition and European operational opportunity
rows.why: Management expects the acquisition to close within six months or in Q1 FY28, with a European opportunity targeted for Q4 FY27 or Q1 FY28, and says it would lift Africa/Middle East success rate from 10% to 20%, subject to due diligence.

rows.label: Positive operating cash flow by March 2027
rows.why: H1 operating cash flow was an outflow of about INR 41 crore, gross receivables are INR 235 crore with INR 81 crore overdue, and most collections are expected in Q3 and Q4.

rows.label: Order inflow of INR 500-600 crore to sustain 25-30% run rate
rows.why: Management expects to add INR 500-600 crore of orders, and another INR 800-850 crore of conversions is expected over the next 12 months in Middle East and Africa, against a current order book above INR 900 crore.

tone.note: Management was confident on H2 execution, the INR 900 crore order book and 25-30% growth, but deferred PEB numbers, JV size, acquisition economics and EPS accretion; analysts pushed on H1 revenue down about 12% YoY, the H2 ramp needing roughly 2x H1, and negative operating cash flow.
